hook_candidates.headline: Score clients with AI, not guesswork.
Stop guessing if clients will pay on time.
Is this client worth your time?

caption:
Client scoring has always been guesswork. What if you could get a confidence score instead? Jev’s API gives floating-point numbers for yes/no questions, like 'Is this client likely to pay on time?'

At $0.042/million tokens (input only), it’s cheaper than GPT-5 Nano for high-volume use. Here’s how to use it:

Copy this prompt:

'Rate this client on a scale of 0.0 to 1.0:

Name: [Client Name]
Company: [Company]
Payment history: [History]

Score:'

The API will return a number like 0.87. Use that to prioritize clients or reject bad ones.

Save this prompt — it’s a time-saver for every client decision.
